comment:
* A floating toolbar for showing contextual menu items.
 * This view shows as many menu item buttons as can fit in the horizontal toolbar and the
 * the remaining menu items in a vertical overflow view when the overflow button is clicked.
 * The horizontal toolbar morphs into the vertical overflow view.

variables.name: mMenuItemComparator
variables.comment: * Sorts the list of menu items to conform to certain requirements.

methods.name: public FloatingToolbar setMenu(Menu menu)
methods.comment:
* Sets the menu to be shown in this floating toolbar.
     * NOTE: Call {@link #updateLayout()} or {@link #show()} to effect visual changes to the
     * toolbar.

methods.name: public FloatingToolbar setOnMenuItemClickListener(MenuItem.OnMenuItemClickListener menuItemClickListener)
methods.comment: * Sets the custom listener for invocation of menu items in this floating toolbar.

methods.name: public FloatingToolbar setContentRect(Rect rect)
methods.comment:
* Sets the content rectangle. This is the area of the interesting content that this toolbar
     * should avoid obstructing.
     * NOTE: Call {@link #updateLayout()} or {@link #show()} to effect visual changes to the
     * toolbar.

methods.name: public FloatingToolbar setSuggestedWidth(int suggestedWidth)
methods.comment:
* Sets the suggested width of this floating toolbar.
     * The actual width will be about this size but there are no guarantees that it will be exactly
     * the suggested width.
     * NOTE: Call {@link #updateLayout()} or {@link #show()} to effect visual changes to the
     * toolbar.

methods.name: public FloatingToolbar updateLayout()
methods.comment:
* Updates this floating toolbar to reflect recent position and view updates.
     * NOTE: This method is a no-op if the toolbar isn't showing.

methods.name: public void hide()
methods.comment:
* Hides this floating toolbar. This is a no-op if the toolbar is not showing.
     * Use {@link #isHidden()} to distinguish between a hidden and a dismissed toolbar.

methods.name: public boolean isShowing()
methods.comment: * Returns {@code true} if this toolbar is currently showing. {@code false} otherwise.

methods.name: public boolean isHidden()
methods.comment: * Returns {@code true} if this toolbar is currently hidden. {@code false} otherwise.

methods.name: public void setOutsideTouchable(boolean outsideTouchable, @Nullable PopupWindow.OnDismissListener onDismiss)
methods.comment:
* If this is set to true, the action mode view will dismiss itself on touch events outside of
     * its window. The setting takes effect immediately.
     *
     * @param outsideTouchable whether or not this action mode is "outside touchable"
     * @param onDismiss optional. Sets a callback for when this action mode popup dismisses itself

methods.name: private static List<MenuItem> getVisibleAndEnabledMenuItems(Menu menu)
methods.comment:
* Returns the visible and enabled menu items in the specified menu.
     * This method is recursive.

methodNames: public void setOutsideTouchable(boolean outsideTouchable, @Nullable PopupWindow.OnDismissListener onDismiss)
